integrity: Proof and exact-integer finite checks are included. Prior integrality and complete-graph spread are attributed. Independent audit has not been performed; residual unindexed literature risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple unit-edge graphs on n >= 4 vertices, real Lipschitz potentials and uniform vertex mass. The total-edge deletion envelope is restricted to k <= floor((n-2)/2); the lost-degree envelope to r < n/2. Weighted metrics, nonuniform masses, and other budgets are outside scope.
title: Two sharp edge-deletion budgets for Lipschitz spread near complete graphs
